about: DrawFiddle's Rust export. Each variant is a list of [source, destination] pairs; a source ending in / is a folder, copied whole. Then: the fiddle code replaces src/app.rs, src/configure.rs calls `configure(ui)` when the code defines `fn configure`, the placeholders are replaced in the text files.

placeholders.myapp: the crate and file name: lowercase letters, digits and _ (a Rust identifier), e.g. pong
placeholders.My App: the name people see: window title, web page title, under the Android and iOS icons
placeholders.121218: the background as RRGGBB, written 0x121218 in src/lib.rs, #121218 in web/index.html, launch_color=121218 in ios/ios.sh

note: A variant's pairs come after the common ones and win on the same destination (Cargo.android.toml over Cargo.toml).
